title: Jeweled Jellylike Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A salty, glassy-jelly Ukrainian dish featuring dried oregano, perfect for a date night, this recipe is raw-friendly and cooked in a kadhai.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together potato starch and salt.
Gradually add in water, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Add dried oregano, black pepper, and minced garlic to the mixture and stir well.
Heat olive oil in a kadhai over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the potato starch mixture into the kadhai.
Cook the dumplings for 5 minutes on each side, until they are translucent and jelly-like.
Remove the dumplings from the kadhai and garnish with dried parsley.
Serve the Jeweled Jellylike Ukrainian Dumplings hot.
Repeat the cooking process for the remaining potato starch mixture.
